description_zh: 查询云连接器实例信息
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc list-iot-cloud-connectors --iot-cloud-connector-status Created --iot-cloud-connector-ids iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --iot-cloud-connector-name test --isp mobile --vpc-id vpc-bp1aevy8sofi8mh1q0000 --apn CMWAP --next-token caeba0bbb2be03f84eb48b699f0a0000 --max-results 10 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --is-in-group false --iot-cloud-connector-group-id iotccg-g00epppbi9di9y0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIoTCloudConnectors

parameters.help_en:
The status of the cloud connector instance. You can specify up to 20 instance statuses. Valid values:  
- **Creating**: Creation in progress.  
- **Created**: Creation completed.  
- **Deleting**: Deletion in progress.  
- **Updating**: Modification in progress.
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例的状态。最多支持输入20个实例状态。取值：
- **Creating**：创建中。
- **Created**：创建完成。
- **Deleting**：删除中。
- **Updating**：修改中
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_status

parameters.help_en: A list of cloud connector instance IDs
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_ids

parameters.help_en:
The name of the cloud connector instance. You can specify up to 20 instance names.

The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). It must start with a letter or a Chinese character
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例的名称。最多支持输入20个实例名称。

名称长度为2~128个字符，以大小写字母或中文开头，可包含数字、下划线（_）或短划线（-）
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_name

parameters.help_en:
The carrier of the cloud connector instance. You can specify up to 20 carriers. Valid values:
- **telecom**: China Telecom.
- **mobile**: China Mobile.
- **unicom**: China Unicom
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例的运营商。最多支持输入20个实例的运营商。取值：
- **telecom**：中国电信。
- **mobile**：中国移动。
- **unicom**：中国联通
parameters.name: isp

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC connected to the cloud connector instance
parameters.help_zh: 云连接器实例连接的VPC的ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the carrier APN.
parameters.name: apn

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether a token for the next query exists. Valid values:
- Do not specify this parameter for the first query or when there is no subsequent query.
- If there is a subsequent query, set this parameter to the **NextToken** value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
- 第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
- 如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的**NextToken**值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return per page when querying results in batches. Valid values: **1** to **50**. Default Value: **10**.
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：**1**~**50**，默认值：**10**
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cloud connector instance.  

You can invoke the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html API to obtain the region ID.
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to query instances in an instance group. Valid values:

- **true**: Query instances in an instance group.

- **false** (default): Do not query instances in an instance group.

- **null**: Query all instances regardless of whether they belong to an instance group
parameters.help_zh:
是否查询实例组中的实例。取值：

- **true**：查询实例组中的实例。

- **false**（默认值）：不查询实例组中的实例。

- **null**：全量查询实例，不区分实例是否在实例组中
parameters.name: is_in_group

parameters.help_en: The group ID of the cloud connector instance.
parameters.name: iot_cloud_connector_group_id
